notes: P04 causal mechanism ablation variants for venue pst (ReceiptMin: Measuring Forensic Reconstructability under Purpose-Bound Audit Minimization). Implemented ABLATION_REGISTRY at evaluation/venue2027/pst/ablations.py with 5 preregistered variants: without_purpose_binding (receipts lack purpose constraint; collapses purpose isolation, causing cross-purpose linkability), without_epoch_rotation (fixed static key; collapses epoch isolation, causing long-term epoch linkability), without_retention_enforcement (retains indefinitely; causes post-retention data exposure), with_common_safety_gate (replaces cryptographic proofs with point-in-time check; admits tampered claims), and full_candidate (reference ceiling). Target contract run_ablation(name, case) -> Outcome implemented. refuse_unregistered_variant enforces fail-closed discipline (UNKNOWN_ABLATION_VARIANT on unknown variants, VARIANT_REMOVES_NOTHING on non-ablation identities). mechanistic_inference_matrix and verify_mechanistic_inference_matrix evaluate 25 variant x family cells over frozen synthetic families with all_cells_match=True. Unit tests in test_ablations.py prove positive degradation for each ablated mechanism, clean control admission, and fail-closed adversarial controls.
